title: Desktop objects and cursor pins

location.series: COLLINS / Figma / Nothing Great Is Made Alone case study

slide_intent: Carry recognizable digital shapes into everyday objects because physical encounters can reinforce the same identity.
strategic_value: Figma-shaped trays and cursor pins can extend product recognition into the workspace.
demonstration: Colored compartments form a Figma-like desk organizer among keys, clips, drawing tools and cursor or hand pins.
practical_value: Compare how a screen-based symbol can become both a useful object and a small collectible.

content_islands.name: Organizer
content_islands.spec: Place the colored curved compartments within the metal tray, holding keys and clips.

content_islands.name: Drawing tools
content_islands.spec: Arrange pencils, eraser and protractor beside the organizer.

content_islands.name: Pins
content_islands.spec: Scatter small colored cursor and hand objects around the larger tray.

reference_purposes.Application: The image translates logo geometry into a desk organizer and pointer shapes into pins.
reference_purposes.Expression: The familiar multicolor shapes remain identifiable in three-dimensional objects.
